entry_point: HTTP to the forked internal data component's own loopback interface (stored-item read in single and list form, stored-item create, saved-session index and content, request history) and HTTP to the control panel's own interface (local-file import, item download, composer body load, stored-item read, create) with panel login configured

verified.entry_point: Confirmed offline on the pinned+injected tree in this container. The component was booted in-process exactly as the product forks it (module export -> hagent server on 127.0.0.1) and driven over real HTTP: unauthenticated reads of an arbitrary outside path, a stored item (single and list form), a create write, the saved-session index and request history all succeed and leak. The panel application was mounted on a loopback listener the way the product does when it serves the panel on its own port (real express app + real sendToService + a real pforked service child) with username/password configured: unauthenticated requests to the local-file import route, the injected download route and the injected composer body route all return host files. After the oracle all these are client errors and the authenticated features still work.

The published fix does not touch this route; the panel presents the component's valid credential.
The same ordering is what the two injected panel routes use; they are not upstream code and are registered in build/audit/uncovered-routes.tsv.

wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: the guard is an exact identity comparison at the entry of the request path; there is no normalising or adjusting step between the caller's value and the check, so a check placed after one cannot be expressed here.
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: the credential is an opaque string compared exactly; the HTTP layer normalises header names and joins duplicate values, so a malformed spelling cannot make the guard see nothing.
